data.rationale: The proposal matches the core procedure (From/To, dates, Search, Continue, Sort & Filter, choose sort, Apply) in the right order, but it omits the payment type (cash/points) parameter and the Points toggle. It also hardcodes sort option text ("Price by Core" tied to the Miami search) instead of treating it cleanly as a parameter, and it doesn't name the month or date inputs precisely, so an automation would need guesswork.
